sourceSentences: If the bonesaw hits an enemy, Dr. Mundo heals for 50% of the health cost, increased to 100% against champions or monsters.

Heart Zapper and its recast will buffer and cast at the end of Infected Bonesaw cast time if attempted to cast during it. As with all buffering of this type, another input such as a movement command can override the buffering of the spell again.

Dr. Mundo charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies and storing of post-mitigation damage he takes as grey health on his health bar, reduced to 25% after the first 0.75 seconds.
Dr. Mundo detonates the defibrillator, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and healing for 50% of grey health, increased to 100% if at least one enemy champion or large monster is hit.
Dr. Mundo empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, and deal bonus physical damage

If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take 100% AD physical damage plus Blunt Force Trauma's minimum bonus damage.
Blunt Force Trauma resets Dr. Mundo's basic attack timer.
Blunt Force Trauma's attack works against structures, consuming the buff and dealing its full damage.

Upon resisting one, Dr. Mundo pays a health cost equal to 4% of his current health and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.

Dr. Mundo can move near the canister to consume it, healing himself for 4% of his maximum health and reducing the cooldown of Goes Where He Pleases by 15 seconds. Enemy champions can move near it to destroy it.
At rank 3, Maximum Dosage's increased base health and bonus health regeneration are both increased by 5% for each enemy champion within 1200 units at the time of cast.
For combos, start with Q, and when you get close, use W. Attack with E before continuing with autoattacks, using Q as often as possible.
heal for half of his gray health, or all of it if he hits a champion or large monster.
He can pick up this canister to restore health and reduce cooldown time, and enemies can step on it to destroy it.
il y a pas vraiment à part le reset d'Uto sur le E
tu vas voir la première auto le reset d'Uto avec le W et ça enfin avec le E
So you can do auto-attack Q auto-attack, or even auto-attack E auto-attack.

Combo number 2: Q, W, auto-attack, E, auto-attack, W. This is the combo you perform when you land a Q. Combo number 3: E, W, auto-attack, auto-attack, W. This is the combo you perform when you hit a minion with your E.
The minion that gets knocked back will deal damage as it passes through, allowing you to poke your opponent.
Note that Blunt Force Trauma works against structures.
don't forget to pick up your canister because it will heal you and significantly reduce the cooldown of your passive.
